outline: This course introduces the fundamental principles and basic applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Deep Learning (DL), and the theory and practical implementation of intelligent fuzzy control. The course combines theory and practice to make students understand AI DL, intelligent control, and their applications.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Fuzzy Control
Week 2: Review of control system dynamics
Week 3: Fuzzy sets / Fuzzy relations / Fuzzy operation
Week 4: Legal holiday
Week 5: Fuzzy implications
Week 6: workshop I/II - membership function Fuzzy control simulation
Week 7: Fuzzy logic control and controller design
Week 8: Legal holiday
Week 9: Fuzzy controller design
Week 10: Legal holiday
Week 11: Writing Exam
Week 12: Introduction to Deep Learning and Machine Learning
Week 13: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and CNN model
Week 14: Image Preprocessing, Deep Learning Model Adjustment
Week 15: Deep Learning and Image Recognition
Week 16: project presentation and demonstration
wk17-18 auxiliary learning
scorePolicy:
Midterm report:30%
Final project (reports, demonstration and presentation):35%
Final writing exam:30%
class performance: 5%
* might be adjusted according to student learning situation
